version: north source pixel traces, adjacent building correction
coordinate_convention: origin top-left; x right; y down
method: Manual vertex trace against the original north aerial, checked with the red/cyan/green/yellow overlay. These are image-space observations for camera inverse projection, not world XY coordinates.

left_field_pavilion.full_exterior_cornice_plane: lower hall roof/cornice; elevation is an inferred plane around z=29
left_field_pavilion.upper_dark_gable_plane: separate roof masses above the cornice; eaves around z=31 and ridge/upper datum around z=34
left_field_pavilion.confidence: medium; roof edges are softened by lighting and occlusion, but the full cornice is visibly larger than the current 40x30 rooftop footprint

north_entertainment_hall.confidence: high; the four corners follow the visible roof and facade break lines and agree with the existing rough footprint projection
